title: The Merchant???

options.title: Browse Merchant
options.description: View the merchant's inventory of relics. Each relic costs [gold]50[/gold] Gold.

options.title: Throw Foul Potion
options.description: Throw a Foul Potion at the merchant to start a combat encounter. You will receive [gold]FakeMerchantsRug[/gold] and all relics in the merchant's inventory.

conditions: At least 100 Gold or has a Foul Potion
notes: This is an interactive merchant event with a custom interface. The merchant stocks 6 randomly-selected relics from a pool of 9: Fake Anchor, Fake Blood Vial, Fake Happy Flower, Fake Lees Waffle, Fake Mango, Fake Orichalcum, Fake Snecko Eye, Fake Strike Dummy, and Fake Venerable Tea Set. Each relic costs [gold]50[/gold] Gold. If the player throws a Foul Potion (obtained from the Foul Apothecary event or as a combat reward), they will face the merchant in combat. Upon victory, they receive the [gold]Fake Merchant's Rug[/gold] relic plus all relics that were in the merchant's inventory.
